# gtm_v1_folder (Data Source)

Gets a GTM Folder.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) The GTM Account ID. The response value is returned in the same attribute.
- `container_id` (String) The GTM Container ID. The response value is returned in the same attribute.
- `folder_id` (String) The GTM Folder ID. The response value is returned in the same attribute.

### Read-Only

- `fingerprint` (String) The fingerprint of the GTM Folder as computed at storage time. This value is recomputed whenever the folder is modified.
- `name` (String) Folder display name.
